C0565.title: Mood-Driven Returns? Woman Convicted for 'Buy Real, Return Fake' Refund Fraud
C0565.summary: In April 2026, Henan Elephant News reported a case exploiting e-commerce return loopholes. A woman purchased genuine items online, then abused the platform's buyer-favored refund review process by returning counterfeits to obtain refunds while keeping the original goods or benefits. She was ultimately held criminally liable for fraud.
